API ReferenceZIdentity APIGroupsGroups Ops Add
Groups Ops Add
POST
https://api.zsapi.net/ziam/admin/api/v1/groups

Creates a new group with the specified name and description.

Request
​
APPLICATION/JSON
BODYREQUIRED
name
string
REQUIRED

The name of the group.

Possible values: <= 128 characters

description
string

A description of the group.

Possible values: <= 256 characters

Responses
​
201
401

The request was successful, and a new group has been created.

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
name
string
REQUIRED

The name of the group.

Possible values: <= 128 characters

description
string

A description of the group.

Possible values: <= 256 characters

id
string
REQUIRED

Unique identifier for the group.

source
SourceType (string)
REQUIRED

The source type of the group.

Possible values: [UI, API, SCIM, JIT]

idp
object
REQUIRED
isDynamicGroup
boolean
REQUIRED

Boolean flag indicating if the group is dynamic.

adminEntitlementEnabled
boolean
REQUIRED

Whether the group supports admin entitlements.

serviceEntitlementEnabled
boolean
REQUIRED

Whether the group supports service entitlements.
